name: vscode-cue
description: The official CUE extension for VS Code, providing syntax highlighting and language server integration (LSP) - from the team that builds CUE and cuelang.org

cue.useLanguageServer.description: Enable cue lsp, the language server for CUE.

cue.cueCommand.description: The command or path used to run the CUE command, cmd/cue. Supports the VS Code variables ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolder:name} and ${userHome}. The value must be a PATH-resolved command name or an absolute path, after variable expansion; relative paths are not supported.

cue.languageServerFlags.description: Flags like -rpc.trace and -logfile to be used while running the language server.

cue.enableEmbeddedFilesSupport.description: Enable CUE LSP for JSON and YAML files. When enabled, the CUE language server will provide features for .json, .yaml, and .yml files based on how they are embedded into .cue files.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: go tool cue cmd genPackageJSON && npm run clean && npm run buildpackage
scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.buildpackage: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.package: vsce package && go tool cue cmd genManifest
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
